coverage.game_states: MENU, PLAYING, PAUSED, and GAME_OVER are implemented
coverage.core_loop: animal intake, condition inspection, station assignment, treatment timing, recovery, release rewards, trust target, and stress failure are implemented
coverage.controls: tap animal inspection, drag to station, station tap, pause, resume, restart, and help are implemented
coverage.progression: day advancement, rising trust target, shorter shift timer, restock, and rewards are implemented
coverage.ui_identity: bottom treatment tray, left intake lane, right station rack, top trust HUD, clinic awning, release gate, and reserved play zones are implemented
coverage.gameplay_art: cow, hen, sheep, goat, piglet, and rabbit use distinct realistic runtime silhouettes with state badges and idle motion
coverage.icon: project icon and upload exports use cow, rabbit, medical kit, red cross, and heart recovery tag
coverage.audio: menu, play, win, fail BGM and event SFX are generated, assigned, and wired through runtime audio code

known_gaps: rare alpaca and pony visitors are planned but not implemented in the current delivery pass
upgrade sheet is represented by day progression and restock rather than a separate upgrade overlay
external multi-frame animal sprite packs are not used because the available CC0 shared animal pack does not cover all required farm species
release_assessment: The implemented build preserves the confirmed veterinary triage loop, visual identity, icon direction, and audio coverage well enough to proceed to packaging.
